about: Fixed A1-A2 words for `run.py skill --learner A1|A2 --cases cases-low.json`: does the skill still write good, level-appropriate cards for a beginner? None is in fixtures/collection.json (checked in BOTH fields: older cards keep the Romanian on the front) except the duplicate. Stress from DEX, checked 2026-10-31.

cases.tests: natural examples want a person as object (o sun pe mama): pe-acuzativ is blocked at A1
wants a dative recipient (îi explic), only learning at A1
reflexive verb: reflexiv-acuzativ is allowed at A1
feminine noun, -ie/-ii plural; kitchen vs cuisine
adjective already inside another card's example, not a card itself
already on a card: must be skipped, not carded
